annotations.title: P-Video Animate: move a character with a video

description: Animate the person or character in one picture with the motion of a source video: the same moves, timing and sound, 720p, as long as the source. Compared with other video tools: budget. Price: from $0.041 per second (one call: from $0.204 per video), charged only on success. Price depends on max_seconds: 5 $0.204, 10 $0.406, 15 $0.609, 20 $0.811 (default 5). With an account API key you pay only for what the call used (per second), never more than this price. One call = one short video.

image.description: Picture of the person or character to animate (https URL). Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)

instruction_prompt.description: Optional extra direction for how the character should move

max_seconds.description: Longest the source video can be; sets the price. Longer videos are refused before anything runs, and not charged. Default 5

video.description: Source video as an MP4 link (https); the result is as long as this video. Or send the file inline as a base64 data: URI (up to 4.5 MB)
